# Book

**Definition.** A physical item held by the library that a member may borrow.

**In context.** Every book is shelved on exactly one shelf and may be the
subject of at most one active loan at a time.

**Distinguish from.** Not to be confused with a catalog record; this term
refers to the physical copy.

> [!note] Notes
> Multiple physical copies of the same title are each a separate Book.
